verified_primary.fact: Two matches went to extra time; none to shootouts
Contemporary general law permits added time for lost time at referee discretion and extends a period for a penalty kick
General penalty-mark procedure: alternating five kicks subject to early decision, then equal-kick sudden death; shootouts do not form part of the match

regulation_label_definition: Score after two 40-minute halves plus associated referee-added time, before any extra time or shootout. Extra-time matches 19 and 21 remain draws for regulation classification.
model_restriction: No knockout advancement or extra-time prediction; unresolved procedures retained as exclusions in this conservative research release.
